app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: Create a new customer profile in Help Scout. Customers represent the people who contact your support team. You can store their contact information, company details, and other relevant data.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 在 Help Scout 中建立新的客戶個人檔案。客戶代表聯絡您支援團隊的人員。您可以儲存他們的聯絡資訊、公司詳細資料以及其他相關資料。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: The age of the customer as a string.
Internal notes or background information about the customer. Maximum 200 characters. This is only visible to your team.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 關於客戶的內部備註或背景資訊。最多 200 個字元。僅您的團隊可見。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: The gender of the customer: male, female, or unknown.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 客戶的性別：male、female 或 unknown。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: The primary email address for the customer. This is used to identify the customer when they send emails to your support address.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 客戶的主要電子郵件地址。當客戶傳送電子郵件至您的支援地址時，此欄位用於識別客戶。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: Categorize the email address type: work (business email), home (personal email), or other.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 將電子郵件地址類型分類：work（商務電子郵件）、home（個人電子郵件）或其他。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: The first name of the customer. Maximum 40 characters.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 客戶的名字。最多 40 個字元。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: The job title or position of the customer. Maximum 60 characters.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 客戶的職稱或職位。最多 60 個字元。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: The company or organization the customer belongs to.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 客戶所屬的公司或組織。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: The geographic location of the customer. Maximum 60 characters.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 客戶的地理位置。最多 60 個字元。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: The last name of the customer. Maximum 40 characters.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 客戶的姓氏。最多 40 個字元。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: The phone number for the customer.
Categorize the phone number type: work, home, mobile, fax, pager, or other.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 將電話號碼類型分類：work、home、mobile、fax、pager 或 other。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: Create a new conversation in Help Scout. A conversation represents an email thread or support ticket with a customer. You must specify the mailbox, customer, and initial message content.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 在 Help Scout 中建立新對話。對話代表與客戶的電子郵件討論串或支援工單。您必須指定信箱、客戶及初始訊息內容。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: The email address of the customer. If the customer does not exist, they will be created. Either Customer ID or Customer Email must be provided.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 客戶的電子郵件地址。若客戶不存在，系統將會建立該客戶。必須提供客戶 ID 或客戶電子郵件地址其中之一。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: The email address of the customer
Select an existing customer from Help Scout. Either Customer ID or Customer Email must be provided.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 從 Help Scout 中選取現有客戶。必須提供客戶 ID 或客戶電子郵件地址其中之一。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: The ID of an existing customer
Optionally assign the conversation to a specific Help Scout user. If not specified, the conversation will be unassigned or follow your mailbox routing rules.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 可選擇將對話指派給特定的 Help Scout 使用者。若未指定，對話將為未指派狀態，或遵循您的信箱路由規則。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: Assign the conversation to a user
When set to true, Help Scout will send an auto-reply to the customer if one is configured for the mailbox. Set to false to prevent auto-replies.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 設為 true 時，若信箱已設定自動回覆，Help Scout 將會傳送自動回覆給客戶。設為 false 可防止自動回覆。
啟用此對話的自動回覆

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: Select the Help Scout mailbox (inbox) where this conversation should be created. Each mailbox typically corresponds to a different support email address or team.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 選取要建立此對話的 Help Scout 信箱（收件匣）。每個信箱通常對應不同的支援電子郵件地址或團隊。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: The mailbox to create the conversation in
The initial status of the conversation. Active means the conversation needs attention, closed means it is resolved, and pending means waiting for customer response.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 對話的初始狀態。Active 表示對話需要處理，closed 表示已解決，pending 表示等待客戶回覆。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: The subject line for the conversation. This will be visible to the customer in email communications.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 對話的主旨行。這將在電子郵件通訊中向客戶顯示。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: A list of tag names to add to the conversation. Tags help organize and categorize conversations for easier filtering and reporting.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 要新增至對話的標籤名稱清單。標籤有助於組織和分類對話，以方便篩選和產生報表。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: Tags to add to the conversation
The text content of the first message in the conversation. This can include HTML formatting.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 對話中第一則訊息的文字內容。可包含 HTML 格式。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: The content of the initial message
The type of the first message in the conversation. Customer means the message is from the customer, reply means it is from your team, and note is an internal note.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 對話中第一則訊息的類型。Customer 表示訊息來自客戶，reply 表示來自您的團隊，note 則為內部備忘。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: The type of the initial thread
The type of conversation: email (standard email thread), phone (phone call record), or chat (live chat conversation).
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 對話類型：email（標準電子郵件討論串）、phone（電話通話記錄）或 chat（線上即時對話）。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX25vdGU.desc.source: Add an internal note to an existing conversation in Help Scout. Notes are only visible to your team members and are not sent to the customer. Use notes to document internal discussions, research, or context about a customer issue.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX25vdGU.desc.message: 在 Help Scout 中的現有對話新增內部備忘。備忘僅對您的團隊成員可見，不會發送給客戶。使用備忘可記錄內部討論、調查或客戶問題的相關背景資訊。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX25vdGU.opti.source: Select or enter the ID of the conversation where you want to add the note. You can search for conversations by number or subject.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX25vdGU.opti.message: 選取或輸入要新增備忘的對話 ID。您可以依編號或主旨搜尋對話。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX25vdGU.opti.source: The conversation to add the note to
Optionally change the conversation status when adding the note. Options include active, closed, open, pending, or spam.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX25vdGU.opti.message: 新增備忘時選擇性變更對話狀態。選項包括 active、closed、open、pending 或 spam。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX25vdGU.opti.source: The text content of the internal note. This can include HTML formatting. The note will only be visible to your team members.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX25vdGU.opti.message: 內部備忘的文字內容。可包含 HTML 格式。此備忘僅對您的團隊成員可見。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX25vdGU.opti.source: The Help Scout user who is adding the note. If not specified, defaults to the authenticated user.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX25vdGU.opti.message: 新增此備忘的 Help Scout 使用者。若未指定，預設為已驗證的使用者。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX25vdGU.shor.source: Add an internal note to a conversation

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX3RhZ3M.desc.source: Add one or more tags to an existing conversation in Help Scout. Tags help organize and categorize conversations for easier filtering, reporting, and workflow automation.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX3RhZ3M.desc.message: 在 Help Scout 中的現有對話新增一個或多個標籤。標籤有助於組織和分類對話，以便進行篩選、產生報表及工作流程自動化。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX3RhZ3M.opti.source: Select or enter the ID of the conversation you want to add tags to.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX3RhZ3M.opti.message: 選取或輸入要新增標籤的對話 ID。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX3RhZ3M.opti.source: The conversation to add tags to
A list of tag names to add to the conversation. Tags are case-insensitive and will be created if they do not already exist.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YWRkX3RhZ3M.opti.message: 要新增至對話的標籤名稱清單。標籤不區分大小寫，若尚不存在則會自動建立。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YXNzaWduZWRfY29u.source: This trigger fires whenever a conversation is assigned to a user in Help Scout. This includes both new assignments and reassignments.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YXNzaWduZWRfY29u.message: 每當在 Help Scout 中將對話指派給使用者時觸發此觸發條件。這包含新指派與重新指派。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YXNzaWduZWRfY29u.source: Optionally filter to only trigger for conversations in a specific mailbox. Leave empty to trigger for all mailboxes.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YXNzaWduZWRfY29u.message: 選擇性篩選僅針對特定信箱中的對話觸發。留空以針對所有信箱觸發。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.YXNzaWduZWRfY29u.source: Triggers when a conversation is assigned

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2N1c3RvbWVy.source: Retrieve the full details of a specific customer from Help Scout by their ID. Returns all customer data including contact information, organization, and custom fields.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2N1c3RvbWVy.message: 依 ID 從 Help Scout 擷取特定客戶的完整詳細資料。傳回所有客戶資料，包含聯絡資訊、組織和自訂欄位。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2N1c3RvbWVy.source: Select or enter the ID of the customer whose profile you want to retrieve.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2N1c3RvbWVy.message: 選取或輸入要擷取其個人資料的客戶 ID。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2N1c3RvbWVy.source: Retrieve a single customer by ID
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2N1c3RvbWVy.message: 依 ID 擷取單一客戶

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.source: Retrieve a company-wide performance report from Help Scout. Includes metrics like customers helped, closed conversations, total replies, and happiness scores. Only available on Plus and Pro plans.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.message: 從 Help Scout 擷取全公司效能報表。包含協助的客戶數、已結案對話數、總回覆數和滿意度評分等指標。僅適用於 Plus 和 Pro 方案。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.source: The end date and time for the reporting period in ISO 8601 format.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.message: 報表週期的結束日期與時間，採用 ISO 8601 格式。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.source: Comma-separated list of folder IDs to filter the report by.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.message: 用於篩選報表的資料夾 ID 逗號分隔清單。
依資料夾 ID 篩選

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.source: Comma-separated list of mailbox IDs to filter the report by.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.message: 用於篩選報表的信箱 ID 逗號分隔清單。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.source: The start date and time for the reporting period in ISO 8601 format.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.message: 報表週期的開始日期與時間，採用 ISO 8601 格式。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.source: The end date for a previous period to compare against. Used to calculate deltas.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.message: 用於比較的上一週期結束日期。用於計算增減差值。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.source: The start date for a previous period to compare against. Used to calculate deltas.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.message: 用於比較的上一週期開始日期。用於計算增減差值。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.source: Comma-separated list of tag IDs to filter the report by.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.message: 用於篩選報表的標籤 ID 逗號分隔清單。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.source: Filter by conversation type: email, chat, or phone.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbXBhbnlf.message: 依對話類型篩選：email、chat 或 phone。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbnZlcnNh.source: Retrieve the full details of a specific conversation from Help Scout by its ID. Returns all conversation data including subject, status, customer information, tags, and custom fields.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbnZlcnNh.message: 依據 ID 從 Help Scout 擷取特定對話的完整詳細資料。傳回所有對話資料，包含主旨、狀態、客戶資訊、標籤及自訂欄位。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbnZlcnNh.source: Select or enter the ID of the conversation you want to retrieve.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbnZlcnNh.message: 選取或輸入您要擷取的對話 ID。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbnZlcnNh.source: Retrieve a single conversation by ID
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2NvbnZlcnNh.message: 依 ID 擷取單一對話

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.source: Retrieve an email channel performance report from Help Scout. Includes volume metrics, resolution times, response times, and time distribution data. Only available on Plus and Pro plans.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.message: 從 Help Scout 擷取電子郵件管道效能報告。包含處理量指標、解決時間、回應時間及時間分布資料。僅適用於 Plus 與 Pro 方案。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.source: The end date and time for the reporting period in ISO 8601 format.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.message: 報表週期的結束日期與時間，採用 ISO 8601 格式。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.source: Comma-separated list of folder IDs to filter the report by.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.message: 用於篩選報表的資料夾 ID 逗號分隔清單。
依資料夾 ID 篩選

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.source: When set to true, time-based metrics will only consider office hours. Defaults to false.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.message: 設為 true 時，基於時間的指標將僅考量上班時間。預設為 false。
在計算中考量上班時間

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.source: Comma-separated list of mailbox IDs to filter the report by.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.message: 用於篩選報表的信箱 ID 逗號分隔清單。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.source: The start date and time for the reporting period in ISO 8601 format.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.message: 報表週期的開始日期與時間，採用 ISO 8601 格式。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.source: The end date for a previous period to compare against. Used to calculate deltas.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.message: 用於比較的上一週期結束日期。用於計算增減差值。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.source: The start date for a previous period to compare against. Used to calculate deltas.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.message: 用於比較的上一週期開始日期。用於計算增減差值。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.source: Comma-separated list of tag IDs to filter the report by.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X2VtYWlsX3Jl.message: 用於篩選報表的標籤 ID 逗號分隔清單。
取得電子郵件管道效能報告

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X3RocmVhZA.d.source: Retrieve the full details of a specific thread (message) within a conversation. Returns the thread content, type, status, and metadata.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X3RocmVhZA.d.message: 擷取對話內特定討論串 (訊息) 的完整詳細資料。傳回討論串內容、類型、狀態及中繼資料。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X3RocmVhZA.o.source: Select or enter the ID of the conversation that contains the thread.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X3RocmVhZA.o.message: 選取或輸入包含該討論串的對話 ID。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X3RocmVhZA.o.source: Enter the ID of the specific thread you want to retrieve.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X3RocmVhZA.o.message: 輸入您要擷取的特定討論串 ID。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X3RocmVhZA.s.source: Retrieve a specific thread by ID
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.Z2V0X3RocmVhZA.s.message: 依 ID 擷取特定討論串

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.ZGVsZXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: Delete a customer profile from Help Scout. Be cautious as this action may affect conversation history and is typically irreversible.

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **Help Scout** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message:
使用已設定連線的驗證向 **Help Scout** 發出自訂 HTTP / REST API 呼叫。

指定 HTTP 方法、URI 路徑（相對於連線的 API 基準 URL）、選用查詢參數、標頭和請求主體。回應將以包含狀態碼、回應標頭和回應主體的雜湊傳回。

當端點尚未在此應用程式中公開為一級動作時，請使用此動作。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: The request body. The effective type depends on `body_type`: JSON/form/YAML expect a hash, XML/text expect a string, multipart expects a file structure, binary expects raw bytes.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 請求主體。有效類型取決於 `body_type`：JSON/表單/YAML 預期為雜湊，XML/文字預期為字串，multipart 預期為檔案結構，二進位預期為原始位元組。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Upload a file using `multipart/form-data`. The body must be a @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" structure (filename + content + mime_type). The framework builds the multipart envelope and sets the boundary header.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 使用 `multipart/form-data` 上傳檔案。主體必須是 @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" 結構 (filename + content + mime_type)。框架會建立 multipart 信封並設定 boundary 標頭。
使用 multipart/form-data 上傳檔案

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Pass the body to the REST client unchanged; the client decides serialization based on its configured `data` option and the value type
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 將主體原封不動地傳遞給 REST 用戶端；用戶端會根據其設定的 `data` 選項與數值類型來決定序列化方式

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Pass-through; use connection serialization and let the REST client decide
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 透傳；使用連線序列化並由 REST 用戶端決定

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Send the body as raw bytes. The body must be a binary value. Sets `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` unless overridden by `hdr`.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 將主體作為原始位元組傳送。主體必須是二進位值。除非被 `hdr` 覆寫，否則會設定 `Content-Type: application/octet-stream`。
將主體作為原始位元組傳送

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Serialize a hash of form fields as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. The body must be a hash whose values are scalars (strings/numbers/booleans).
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 將表單欄位的雜湊序列化為 `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`。主體必須是值為純量 (字串/數字/布林值) 的雜湊。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Serialize body as application/x-www-form-urlencoded form fields
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 將主體序列化為 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 表單欄位

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Serialize the body as JSON; sets `Content-Type: application/json`. The body should be a hash, list, or scalar value.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 將主體序列化為 JSON；設定 `Content-Type: application/json`。主體應為雜湊、清單或純量值。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Send the body as plain text. The body must be a string. Sets `Content-Type: text/plain`.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 將主體作為純文字傳送。主體必須是字串。設定 `Content-Type: text/plain`。
將主體作為 text/plain 傳送

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Send the body as XML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to XML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/xml`.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 將主體作為 XML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 XML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/xml`。
將主體作為 XML 傳送

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Send the body as YAML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to YAML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 將主體作為 YAML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 YAML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`。
將主體作為 YAML 傳送

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Selects the body serialization mode and the corresponding `Content-Type` header. Changing this field reshapes the `body` editor - selecting JSON exposes a JSON editor, selecting Multipart Form exposes a file picker, and so on.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 選擇主體序列化模式與相應的 `Content-Type` 標頭。變更此欄位會重塑 `body` 編輯器 - 選擇 JSON 會顯示 JSON 編輯器，選擇 Multipart Form 會顯示檔案選擇器，依此類推。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: How the body is serialized and what Content-Type is sent
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 主體如何序列化以及傳送何種 Content-Type

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: If `True`, non-2xx HTTP responses return as the normal response hash (with the actual status code) instead of raising `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`. Useful for handling 4xx/5xx as data - e.g. checking whether a resource exists. Overrides the connection's `error_passthru` setting for this call only.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 若為 `True`，非 2xx 的 HTTP 回應將作為正常的回應雜湊 (包含實際狀態碼) 返回，而不是引發 `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`。適用於將 4xx/5xx 作為資料處理 - 例如檢查資源是否存在。僅針對本次呼叫覆寫連線的 `error_passthru` 設定。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Return non-2xx responses normally instead of throwing
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 正常返回非 2xx 回應，而不是拋出例外

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Optional list of HTTP status codes treated as success. If set and the response status is not in this list, the action throws `REST-STATUS-ERROR`. When unset, the REST client's default behavior applies (typically: 2xx is success, non-2xx throws).
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 視為成功的選擇性 HTTP 狀態碼清單。若已設定且回應狀態不在此清單中，該動作將拋出 `REST-STATUS-ERROR`。未設定時，套用 REST 用戶端的預設行為 (通常：2xx 代表成功，非 2xx 拋出例外)。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Response status codes treated as success
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 視為成功的回應狀態碼

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Hash of custom headers added to the request. These override any default headers set by `body_type` (e.g. supplying `Content-Type` here wins over the body-type default).
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 新增至請求的自訂標頭雜湊。這些會覆寫由 `body_type` 設定的任何預設標頭 (例如：在此處提供 `Content-Type` 會優先於主體類型的預設值)。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: If `True`, the response hash includes a `debug` sub-hash containing the request method/URL/headers (with sensitive values redacted), request and response sizes, and round-trip duration. Useful when investigating slow or failing calls. Off by default to keep responses lean.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 若為 `True`，回應雜湊包含一個 `debug` 子雜湊，其中包含請求方法/URL/標頭 (敏感值已遮蔽)、請求與回應大小以及來回時間。在調查過慢或失敗的呼叫時很有用。預設關閉以維持回應精簡。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Include request/timing/size debug info in the response
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 在回應中包含請求/時序/大小除錯資訊

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: The HTTP method to use for the request

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 用於請求的 HTTP 方法

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: The URI path relative to the connection's API base URL. May contain `{name}` placeholders that are replaced from `path_vars`. Example: `/users/{id}/comments`.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 相於連線 API 基本 URL 的 URI 路徑。可能包含從 `path_vars` 替換的 `{name}` 預留位置。範例：`/users/{id}/comments`。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: The URI path relative to the connection's API base URL
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 相對於連線 API 基礎 URL 的 URI 路徑

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Hash of values substituted into `{name}` placeholders in the URI path. Example: with `path = /users/{id}` and `path_vars = {id: 123}` the framework sends `/users/123`. Values are URL-encoded.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 替換至 URI 路徑中 `{name}` 預留位置的值 Hash。範例：使用 `path = /users/{id}` 與 `path_vars = {id: 123}` 時，框架會傳送 `/users/123`。數值均經過 URL 編碼。
路徑中 {name} 預留位置的值

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Hash of query string parameters to append to the URI path. Values are URL-encoded; list values are joined with `,`.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 要附加至 URI 路徑的查詢字串參數 Hash。數值均經過 URL 編碼；清單值會使用 `,` 連接。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Make a custom API call to Help Scout
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 向 Help Scout 發出自訂 API 呼叫

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bmV3X29yZ2FuaXph.source: This trigger fires whenever a new organization is created in Help Scout. Organizations help group customers from the same company.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bmV3X29yZ2FuaXph.message: 每當在 Help Scout 中建立新組織時，此觸發程序即會觸發。組織有助於將來自同一家公司的客戶分組。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bmV3X29yZ2FuaXph.source: Triggers when a new organization is created

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bmV3X2N1c3RvbWVy.source: This trigger fires whenever a new customer is created in Help Scout. It provides the full customer profile including contact information, organization, and custom fields.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bmV3X2N1c3RvbWVy.message: 每當在 Help Scout 中建立新客戶時，此觸發程序即會觸發。它會提供完整的客戶個人檔案，包括聯絡資訊、組織和自訂欄位。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bmV3X2N1c3RvbWVy.source: Triggers when a new customer is created

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bmV3X2NvbnZlcnNh.source: This trigger fires whenever a new conversation (support ticket) is created in Help Scout. You can optionally filter by mailbox to only receive events from specific inboxes.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bmV3X2NvbnZlcnNh.message: 每當在 Help Scout 中建立新對話（支援工單）時，此觸發程序即會觸發。您可以選擇依信箱篩選，僅接收來自特定收件匣的事件。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bmV3X2NvbnZlcnNh.source: Optionally filter to only trigger for conversations in a specific mailbox. Leave empty to trigger for all mailboxes.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bmV3X2NvbnZlcnNh.message: 選擇性篩選僅針對特定信箱中的對話觸發。留空以針對所有信箱觸發。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.bmV3X2NvbnZlcnNh.source: Triggers when a new conversation is created

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VhcmNoX2N1c3Rv.source: Search for customers in Help Scout using a query string. You can search by email, name, phone number, or other customer properties using Help Scout query syntax.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VhcmNoX2N1c3Rv.message: 使用查詢字串在 Help Scout 中搜尋客戶。您可以使用 Help Scout 查詢語法依電子郵件、姓名、電話號碼或其他客戶屬性進行搜尋。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VhcmNoX2N1c3Rv.source: The maximum number of customer records to return. Default is 50.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VhcmNoX2N1c3Rv.message: 要傳回的客戶記錄數上限。預設為 50。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VhcmNoX2N1c3Rv.source: Maximum number of customers to return
The direction to sort results: desc (newest first) or asc (oldest first).
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VhcmNoX2N1c3Rv.message: 排序結果的方向：desc（最新的在前）或 asc（最舊的在前）。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VhcmNoX2N1c3Rv.source: The field to sort results by: createdAt, firstName, lastName, or modifiedAt.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VhcmNoX2N1c3Rv.message: 用於排序結果的欄位：createdAt、firstName、lastName 或 modifiedAt。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VhcmNoX2N1c3Rv.source: The search query using Help Scout query syntax. Examples: (email:"john@example.com"), (firstName:"John"), (phone:"555-1234"). You can combine multiple conditions with AND/OR operators.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VhcmNoX2N1c3Rv.message: 使用 Help Scout 查詢語法的搜尋查詢。範例：(email:"john@example.com")、(firstName:"John")、(phone:"555-1234")。您可以使用 AND/OR 運算子結合多個條件。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VhcmNoX2N1c3Rv.source: Search for customers using a query

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.d.source: Send a reply to an existing conversation in Help Scout. The reply will be sent to the customer via email. You can optionally CC/BCC additional recipients, save as draft, or change the conversation status.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.d.message: 向 Help Scout 中的現有對話傳送回覆。回覆將透過電子郵件傳送給客戶。您可以選擇將其他收件者設為副本/密件副本、儲存為草稿或變更對話狀態。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.source: Select or enter the ID of the conversation you want to reply to.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.message: 選取或輸入您要回覆的對話 ID。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.source: A list of email addresses to CC on the reply. These recipients will receive a copy of the email.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.message: 回覆中要設為副本的電子郵件地址清單。這些收件者將收到該電子郵件的副本。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.source: Select the customer who will receive this reply. This should match the customer associated with the conversation.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.message: 選擇將接收此回覆的客戶。這應與對話關聯的客戶相符。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.source: Optionally assign the conversation to a different Help Scout user after sending the reply.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.message: 傳送回覆後，可選擇將對話指派給其他 Help Scout 使用者。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.source: A list of email addresses to BCC on the reply. These recipients will receive a copy of the email without other recipients knowing.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.message: 回覆中要設為密件副本的電子郵件地址清單。這些收件者將收到該電子郵件的副本，且其他收件者不會知情。
密件副本電子郵件地址

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.source: When set to true, the reply is saved as a draft and not sent to the customer. You can review and send it later from Help Scout.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.message: 當設為 true 時，回覆會儲存為草稿且不會傳送給客戶。您可以稍後在 Help Scout 中檢閱並傳送。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.source: Save the reply as a draft
Optionally change the conversation status after sending the reply. For example, set to closed after resolving an issue.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.message: 傳送回覆後可選擇變更對話狀態。例如，在解決問題後設為已關閉。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.source: The text content of the reply message. This can include HTML formatting. The reply will be sent to the customer via email.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.message: 回覆訊息的文字內容。可包含 HTML 格式。回覆將透過電子郵件傳送給客戶。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.source: The Help Scout user sending the reply. If not specified, defaults to the authenticated user.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.o.message: 傳送回覆的 Help Scout 使用者。若未指定，預設為已驗證的使用者。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.c2VuZF9yZXBseQ.s.source: Send a reply to a conversation

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: Update the profile information of an existing customer in Help Scout. You can modify their name, contact details, organization, and other profile fields.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 更新 Help Scout 中現有客戶的個人檔案資訊。您可以修改其姓名、聯絡詳細資訊、組織及其他個人檔案欄位。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: Select the customer whose profile you want to update.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 選擇要更新其個人檔案的客戶。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: Update the age of the customer.
Update the internal background notes about the customer. Maximum 200 characters.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 更新有關客戶的內部背景備註。最多 200 個字元。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: Update the gender of the customer: male, female, or unknown.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 更新客戶的性別：male、female 或 unknown。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: Update the first name of the customer. Maximum 40 characters.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 更新客戶的名字。最多 40 個字元。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: Update the job title of the customer. Maximum 60 characters.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 更新客戶的職稱。最多 60 個字元。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: Update the company or organization of the customer.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 更新客戶的公司或組織。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: Update the geographic location of the customer. Maximum 60 characters.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 更新客戶的地理位置。最多 60 個字元。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.source: Update the last name of the customer. Maximum 40 characters.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2N1c3Rv.message: 更新客戶的姓氏。最多 40 個字元。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: Update the properties of an existing conversation in Help Scout. You can change the subject, status, or assignee. At least one field must be provided to update.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 更新 Help Scout 中的現有對話屬性。您可以變更主旨、狀態或被指派人。必須提供至少一個欄位以進行更新。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: Select or enter the ID of the conversation you want to update.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 選取或輸入您要更新的對話 ID。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: Assign or reassign the conversation to a specific Help Scout user.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 將對話指派或重新指派給特定的 Help Scout 使用者。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: Update the status of the conversation. Options include active, closed, or pending.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 更新對話的狀態。選項包括 active、closed 或 pending。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbnZl.source: Update the subject line of the conversation. This will be visible to the customer in email communications.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbnZl.message: 更新對話的主旨行。此資訊將在電子郵件通訊中顯示給客戶。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlZF9jdXN0.source: This trigger fires whenever a customer profile is updated in Help Scout. It provides the updated customer data including any changed fields.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlZF9jdXN0.message: 每當在 Help Scout 中更新客戶個人檔案時觸發此觸發器。它會提供更新後的客戶資料，包含任何已變更的欄位。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.action.dXBkYXRlZF9jdXN0.source: Triggers when a customer is updated

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.desc.source: Integrate with Help Scout to manage customer support conversations, create and update customers, send replies, and track support interactions. This integration enables you to automate support workflows, respond to customers, and maintain customer relationships through Help Scout.
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.desc.message: 與 Help Scout 整合以管理客戶支援對話、建立與更新客戶、傳送回覆並追蹤支援互動。此整合可讓您透過 Help Scout 自動化支援工作流程、回覆客戶並維護客戶關係。

app.SGVscFNjb3V0.short_desc.source: Connect with Help Scout to manage customer conversations and support tickets
app.SGVscFNjb3V0.short_desc.message: 連線至 Help Scout 以管理客戶對話與支援工單
